prompt: Create an original 90 second ambient electronic instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: analog pads, granular synth, soft sub bass. Style: slow evolving textures without drums or a beat. Tempo approximately 56 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A grand and evolving orchestral piece, starting with ethereal pads and strings, gradually building in complexity and intensity with the introduction of brass, percussion, and arpeggiated synthesizers. It transitions from a calm, majestic opening to a more epic and dramatic soundscape, maintaining a cinematic feel throughout before a serene fade-out.
description.zh: 一首宏大且不断演进的管弦乐作品，以空灵的合成器音色和弦乐开场，随后逐渐加入铜管乐、打击乐和琶音合成器，层层递进，增强复杂性和强度。音乐从平静、庄严的开场过渡到更具史诗感和戏剧性的音景，始终保持电影般的氛围，最终以宁静的淡出结束。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
